Class OidcSignUpService

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.oidc.OidcSignUpService
public final class OidcSignUpService extends Object
Confirms a pending sign-up through the application's WhoSignUpPolicy, or links a pending account to the identity signed in. Each runs in its own transaction. Two browsers confirming the same account at once both end up signed in to the one identity that won.

    • OidcSignUpService

      public OidcSignUpService(WhoSignUpPolicy policy, WhoService whoService, IdentityRepository identities, FederatedCredentialRepository credentials, FederatedCredentialService credentialService, CredentialIdentityRepository credentialIdentities, WhoEventPublisher eventPublisher, Clock clock, org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager transactionManager)
      Creates the service.
      Parameters:
      policy - decides whether an account may sign up
      whoService - resolves a credential to its identity
      identities - stores the new identity
      credentials - stores the account's credential
      credentialService - links an account to a signed-in identity
      credentialIdentities - links a credential to an identity
      eventPublisher - where events are published
      clock - stamps the events
      transactionManager - runs each confirmation in a transaction of its own
